comparison: retain every timing; compare medians separately for every case without trimming or pooling; no release gate
correctness: exact complete execution-report equality between baseline and candidate for every invocation
measurement: perf_counter_ns around full execute_program including mandatory re-verification and report generation; canonical JSON bytes already in memory
order: rotate cases by round; baseline/candidate order reversed on odd rounds
scope: Python interpreter wall time only; not native code, compilation, NDU lifecycle or Agent productivity
